verdict.rationale: Microsoft's FAQ documents App Lock: when enabled, the app asks for the device PIN or biometric every time Authenticator opens (docs-6), and Microsoft says it is meant to protect OTP codes, app information and settings (docs-17). That directly covers someone opening the app on a borrowed or unattended phone. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that App Lock works as described, and detail on whether it is on by default or configurable (e.g. timeout).
